# Project Brief

## Project Name

Duncan Falconer — Healthcare Interoperability & Technical Architecture Portfolio

## Goal

Replace the old Flask/Heroku personal profile site with a modern, low-cost, static-first Astro portfolio.

The site should present Duncan as a Technical Architect and Healthcare Interoperability specialist, with practical experience in software development, healthcare standards, documentation, governance, and delivery.

## Primary Audience

- Healthcare technology colleagues
- HSE and European interoperability stakeholders
- Recruiters or hiring panels
- Technical collaborators
- Standards and interoperability professionals
- People reviewing Duncan's GitHub work

## Core Message

Duncan designs, builds, and explains standards-based healthcare interoperability solutions using FHIR, CDA, APIs, and practical web technologies.

## Key Themes

- Healthcare interoperability
- HL7 FHIR
- CDA, XML, JSON
- MyHealth@EU
- Patient Summary
- Medical imaging interoperability
- Python, Flask, Django
- Angular and TypeScript
- APIs and technical architecture
- Governance and practical delivery

## Main Pages

- Home
- About
- Projects
- Case Studies
- Interoperability Lab
- Timeline
- Contact

## Design Direction

Clean, professional, accessible, calm, and modern.

The design should feel credible for healthcare, public-sector technology, and technical architecture.

Avoid flashy portfolio clichés.
